transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Back away from the rim. Sound carries over the oil, and the well keeps what it hears.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'm Salim. I came for my brother Omar.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Softly. The stone carries sound farther than you think, and the well keeps what it hears.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: He vanished near this well.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Vanished is common here. Names thin first, then faces, and fear makes it faster.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I won't forget him.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Everyone says that at the start.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Why are you still here?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Because I am bound to this fountain and cannot leave it. Stand too long here and this place keeps you.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: How long have you been trapped?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Long enough that days slip and faces blur. Yesterday I forgot my mother's face. That frightened me more than the black water ever could.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Can you help me find Omar?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: No. I cannot guide you, and I cannot leave this place. Touch that dark surface and it will take more than your skin.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: It was my idea. I dared Omar to come back to the edge.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Then you brought pride with you. Why speak his name so freely when names are the first thing this place erases?

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I won't leave without him.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Guilt rings louder than shouting. If you carry it raw, this place will scrape at your mind. What are you willing to lose for him?

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Anything.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: That word costs nothing here. The dark water takes faces, not hunger. It does it slowly, so you keep hoping.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: He trusted me.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I believe you. My head aches when I listen this closely. Something tightens behind my eyes when the grief comes close.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Can you hold this place off long enough to help me?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: The king's reach bends people inward — strong words echo here long after you've forgotten saying them. Be careful with what you promise.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Please don't turn me away.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I haven't. I am tired, and helping costs me more forgetting. Taking blame is easy. Keeping your mind intact is harder.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I need your words.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Helping you is dangerous. The village eyes notice when I care. The black surface is rising faster now, and my jaw will not unclench.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I won't waste it.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Not yet. The windows go still when I prepare to speak. My hands are shaking. Once I begin, there is no taking it back.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'm ready.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Courage in my chest. Fire in my will. I do not break. Say it once.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Courage in my chest. Fire in my will. I do not break.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Don't repeat it. The square listens for echoes. There is one more — harder to give. My hands won't stop.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I am still here.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Prayer for the lost: Light find my hand. Light find my path. Let the Sword of Light answer, and let it fade when the shadows loosen. Never say it twice in the same dark.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I have both. I won't waste them.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Use the first when you feel yourself slipping. Use the second only when the pale hands reach you — not before. The order matters.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'll remember you.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Memory leaks here. Intention lasts longer.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'm going, for Omar.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: If the dark surface swells, do not stare it down. Keep your mind narrow and your steps steady. Don't waste what I gave you.
